title: The Mosaic of Our Story
alt: The Mosaic of Our Story: wavy strips of cobalt lace with mint leaves stitched over gold aso-oke
intro: A commissioned wall piece: strips of cobalt lace, cut and composed over gold aso-oke, finished with mint leaf appliqués and acrylic beads.

chapters.title: Gather
chapters.text: The piece began with the fabrics: deep cobalt lace scattered with sequins, mint and gold guipure leaves, and a woven gold aso-oke for the ground.

images.alt: Folded gold aso-oke catching the light

chapters.title: Cut
chapters.text: The lace was cut by hand into long wavy strips, following the scallops already in the pattern, and the leaves were freed one by one.

images.alt: Mint lace leaves cut out and laid on gold aso-oke
Cut lace strips and leaves on the cutting table with a tray of beads

chapters.title: Compose
chapters.text: Strips were laid out, moved and layered — first as chevrons, then as flowing vertical waves — until the rhythm of the piece held together.

images.alt: Lace strips composed in a chevron on aso-oke
Layered lace strips and leaves in progress
Early experiment with frayed threads and lace

chapters.title: Stitch
chapters.text: Everything was stitched and beaded into place, then backed, labelled and wrapped by hand in organza for delivery.

images.alt: Close-up of a stitched mint leaf with sequins
The sewn-in Nuaj label on the back of the piece
The finished piece wrapped in organza with a ribbon

gallery.alt: The finished mosaic: vertical waves of cobalt lace over gold aso-oke
The finished piece hanging in afternoon light
Detail of lace strips and leaves
